Method of Attack: Remote code execution through PHP code injection via /includes/backup-heart.php file
Control of values passed to an include leading to arbitrary PHP code execution
Unauthenticated attackers submitting specially-crafted requests to execute arbitrary commands on the server
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using Backup Migration plugin up to version 1.3.6
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerability in /includes/backup-heart.php via HTTP content-dir header controlling BMI_ROOT_DIR
Unauthenticated remote attack without user interaction
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious PHP code inclusion via bypasser.php in BMI_INCLUDES directory
